quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I just launched SMOG & Co — a digital platform bringing Spreken Met Ondersteuning van Gebaren (SMOG) to life. It’s designed for parents, caregivers, teachers, therapists, and anyone learning Dutch — even horses apparently .

What makes this fun (and maybe ridiculous) is that I built everything solo:

Web app: React SPA, split-pane layout, fast search, favorites, multilingual & GDPR-compliant.

Mobile apps: React Native + Expo, offline-first videos, fully native feel.

Backend: Convex for real-time sync, Hono + oRPC for type-safe APIs, Mux for videos.

Extras: Sponsorship model for non-profits, analytics, offline sync.

Why it’s interesting:

250+ users in 48h.

#6 Education app in Belgian App Store in week one.

Works offline in care homes, schools, and on-the-go.

At 21 years old, this is my first App Store app — and seeing people use something I built completely alone, from backend to mobile apps, is surreal.

Check it out:
Web: app.smog.vlaanderen

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/app/smog-co/id6758547774

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=be.zias.smog
quotes.story_title: Smog and Co – a full offline-first Belgian Sign Language platform
